ROG Ranger BP1500 Gaming Backpack

Pack the Power, Pack the Attitude

  • Stylish, gaming-inspired design: Stand out from the crowd with the cyber-text pattern, military-style triangular base-corner guards, and textured zippers.
  • Capacious storage: Generous 16L interior for easy transport of an up to 15.6’’ notebook, plus quick-access exterior pocket for your essential accessories.
  • Water-repellent and scratch-resistant: Durable exterior materials provide strong, stylish protection for both your notebook and accessories.
  • Comfortably cool to carry: Extensive mesh on backrest area creates an air pocket to keep you cooler when carrying.
  • Adjustable and versatile: Soft, padded shoulder straps easily resize to fit, plus six loops tailored into webbing for added carrying flexibility.

ROG Ranger BP1500
Gaming Backpack

Pack the power. Pack the attitude.

Pack the power.
Pack the attitude.

Durable, Practical Style

ROG Ranger BP1500 Gaming Backpack is a lightweight laptop carry case embellished with futuristic cyber-text interpretations of the iconic Republic of Gamers brand name and logo. The Ranger BP1500 is made of a sleek, durable 900D polyester that repels water and is great at resisting scratches. Military-inspired corner guards prevent fraying, keeping both Ranger BP1500 and your laptop protected from everyday knocks and bumps.

Expand Your Storage
Expectations

Ranger BP1500 offers a 16-liter storage capacity and great flexibility. Along with a large, padded pouch that accommodates a 15.6-inch laptop, there's a second cushioned pocket for a 10-inch tablet. These tailored sleeves limit movement, providing snug protection for one or both devices.   There's also a large front zipped pocket for miscellaneous gear. This additionally conceals three internal slip pouches for two pens and an up to 6.2-inch smartphone.

Cool, Adjustable and Secure Comfort

The Ranger BP1500 has an articulated back support that's enrobed in air mesh to keep you cool and comfortable as you travel. Adjustable padded shoulder straps ensure a secure fit, while loops woven into the webbing offer additional battleground-inspired carry capability. A built-in luggage strap adds another layer of everyday convenience, enabling you to quickly secure the Ranger BP1500 to another case or luggage trolley.
